description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Database Platform Engineer based in the United States. 

 Join a fast-growing technology environment building the infrastructure that powers large-scale artificial intelligence workloads. As a Database Platform Engineer, you will take ownership of database architecture, automation, security, and reliability across a diverse infrastructure landscape. You will design standardized, reusable database management patterns that enable development teams to provision, operate, and maintain databases independently. Working at the intersection of platform engineering, infrastructure automation, and data reliability, you will help strengthen the foundations supporting critical applications and AI workloads. You will drive improvements in database scalability, cost efficiency, access management, and disaster recovery. This is a highly autonomous, hands-on engineering role offering the opportunity to shape platform standards and influence key technical decisions as the organization scales.

Accountabilities
 

 Database Platform Architecture: Design, implement, and maintain standardized database lifecycle patterns across PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis, ClickHouse, and future database technologies, covering provisioning, configuration, monitoring, backups, and decommissioning.

 Infrastructure Automation: Develop and maintain reusable infrastructure-as-code modules and integrate database provisioning and management capabilities into the internal developer platform, enabling self-service operations for engineering teams.

 Database Consolidation and Optimization: Lead database consolidation initiatives while implementing secure multi-service and multi-tenant access controls, dynamic credentials, network restrictions, and audit mechanisms. Optimize infrastructure costs so database spending scales with actual workload demands.

 Database Hosting Strategy: Evaluate and determine the most appropriate hosting architecture for each workload, balancing managed database services and self-hosted solutions based on performance, reliability, security, and cost.

 Migration and Change Management: Establish reliable, forward-only, backward-compatible database migration processes. Integrate migration testing, schema-diff validation, and safeguards for potentially destructive database changes into shared CI/CD pipelines.

 Backup and Disaster Recovery: Own database backup and recovery strategies, including automated backup jobs, point-in-time recovery, restore testing, and self-service database restoration and forking capabilities.

 Security and Access Management: Implement short-lived, service-specific database credentials using Vault, establish role-based permissions and infrastructure access controls, and introduce time-limited administrative access with comprehensive audit trails.

 Reliability and Data Protection: Ensure database content remains protected against accidental deletion, failed deployments, unsuccessful migrations, and infrastructure incidents. Build systems that prevent incomplete or unrecoverable database operations.

 Technical Leadership: Serve as the database subject matter expert, advise engineering teams on architectural decisions, establish technical standards, and continuously improve database management practices across the platform.


 Requirements


 At least 5 years of hands-on experience operating PostgreSQL or MySQL databases in production environments, including replication, failover, backup and recovery, and connection pooling.

 Strong experience automating database infrastructure and lifecycle management using Terraform, with the ability to identify potentially destructive infrastructure changes.

 Proven experience designing forward-only, backward-compatible database migration workflows using tools such as Drizzle, Prisma, Alembic, Atlas, Flyway, or equivalent.

 Experience operating both managed database services, such as Aiven, Amazon RDS, Google Cloud SQL, or Redis Cloud, and self-hosted database environments.

 Strong practical knowledge of HashiCorp Vault, particularly database secrets engines, authentication methods, access policies, and credential lease management.

 Experience implementing OIDC-based infrastructure access using platforms such as Zitadel, Keycloak, Azure AD, Okta, or comparable identity providers.

 Familiarity with stateful workloads running on orchestration platforms such as Nomad or Kubernetes.

 Ability to work confidently with HCL, Python, TypeScript, Go, shell scripting, and SQL.

 Demonstrated experience operating database automation in production, including handling migration conflicts, connection pooler interactions, lock contention, credential rotation, and infrastructure provider limitations.

 Strong understanding of database reliability, security, data protection, and recovery principles, with the ability to design systems that remain recoverable even when automated operations fail.

 Excellent problem-solving skills, technical judgment, and a proactive, self-directed approach to identifying and resolving infrastructure challenges.

 Strong ownership mindset, with the ability to work independently, make architectural decisions, and build scalable solutions from the ground up.


 Preferred Qualifications:


 Experience with HashiCorp Nomad and Nomad Pack.

 Hands-on experience operating Zitadel or another self-hosted OpenID Connect identity provider.

 Experience with PgBouncer or similar connection pooling technologies, particularly alongside automated credential rotation.

 Familiarity with Aiven, including its Terraform provider, database forking, and point-in-time recovery capabilities.

 Experience with backup and recovery tools such as Restic, pgBackRest, or WAL-G.

 Knowledge of broader data infrastructure technologies, including ClickHouse, Kafka, and change data capture solutions such as Debezium.

 Experience producing database security, access management, or change management compliance evidence for SOC 2 or comparable frameworks.


 Benefits


 Competitive Salary: Annual compensation ranging from $150,000 to $200,000 USD, depending on experience and qualifications.

 Employment Type: Full-time position.

 Location Flexibility: United States-based opportunity.

 Technical Ownership: Significant autonomy to shape database architecture, infrastructure standards, and platform engineering practices.

 Growth Opportunities: Work on advanced infrastructure supporting large-scale AI workloads and high-performance computing environments.

 Engineering Impact: Opportunity to build foundational systems and directly influence platform reliability, security, scalability, and cost efficiency.
